experience.summary: Owned four hardware systems from design through testing across optics, precision motion, imaging, and substrate handling.
achievements: Developed a laser optics module, automated XY stage, custom microscope camera, and automated substrate loader.
Used Onshape for mechanical design and Rust for software development, alongside hardware development, integration, and technical documentation.
Wrote technical documentation praised by my supervising staff engineer as excellent and to be used as positive examples for future interns.
A recommendation from my internship supervisor is available below; the full letter is available on request.

experience.engagement: Research Assistant & Associate Researcher · Co-op and casual/on-call appointments
experience.affiliationNote: Nano Photonics and Quantum Optics Lab · University of Waterloo
experience.summary: Designed and built PRISM from the ground up as a piezo-actuated XYZ objective-scanning module for optical experiments.
achievements: Designed optical assemblies, fixtures, and instrument components; prepared mechanical drawings, machined parts, and coordinated machining.
Built optical setups, aligned beam paths, and worked on fiber coupling and microscope imaging.
Implemented initial LabVIEW raster-scan control with piezo motion and photon-detector readout; completed initial testing and setup to prepare the instrument for scanning.
PRISM V5 is now used in the lab's confocal setup for diamond NV-center measurements through a cryostat window. The scanning software was subsequently extended for those experiments.

experience.summary: My instrument development began in my professor's lab. I now continue independent optical and precision-tooling projects in my home lab as time permits.
achievements: Current projects include an encoder-equipped stage and a tool for inspecting stage precision.
Share builds and testing on my YouTube channel, KicoLabCO.

Axivion Instruments began with an effort to commercialize PRISM. This included exploring company formation and preparing draft provisional patent documents and technical drawings. No patent application was filed.
Commercialization plans are paused while instrument development continues.
